The '''Pathline Tapcafe''' was a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], in [[Cityblock Kesk-319]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a group of crew members from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' visited the Pathline Tapcafe, hoping to obtain a valuable [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] from a [[Tynial|contact]].

==Description==
The Pathline Tapcafe was a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] that was on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], in [[Cityblock Kesk-319]] at the intersection of [[Route 6903]] and [[Citypath 515]]. One of the dishes it served was [[Gruuvan shaal|Gruuvan ''shaal'']], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. The tapcafe was overseen by a [[Unidentified manager|manager]] and was crewed by several [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] [[Waiter/Legends|waiters]].<ref name="Raid" />

==History==
The Pathline Tapcafe was in existence by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], when the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was being waged between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Empire's [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] began enforcing a [[non-native workers act]] on Brentaal IV that had been passed before the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|disbanded]]. As a result, Imperial personnel arrested the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Tynial]]&mdash;who was secretly sympathetic to the Alliance&mdash;and several other of the Pathline Tapcafe's non-Human waiters and staff for not having the proper identification. This left the manager scrambling for staff, though the Imperials neglected to check the Humans who were not from Brentaal IV for the right identification.<ref name="Raid" />

Two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, a group of crew members from the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' arrived at the Pathline Tapcafe looking for Tynial; the ''Far Orbit'' was actually a [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] for the Alliance, and Tynial was the Alliance contact from whom they were hoping to obtain a valuable [[Datacard/Legends|datadisk]] containing information pertaining to the route of the Imperial [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigate]] [[Emperor's Will (Star Galleon-class)|''Emperor's Will'']].<ref name="Raid" />

{{RPGseed}}
Despite the absence of Tynial, the crew members still asked one of the waiters for Gruuvan ''shaal'', which was the passphrase that they were supposed to use with Tynial. One of the other [[Unidentified Rebel waiter|waiters]] then approached the group and suggested that they go to the nightclub known as [[Jovvitz]] the same evening. The waiter, who was also an Alliance contact, handed over the datadisc to them in Jovvitz that night, though the privateers ended up being chased by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]].<ref name="Raid" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Pathline Tapcafe first appeared in ''[[Raid on Brentaal]]'', an adventure scenario in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the privateering vessel ''Far Orbit''. Although it is not suggested, players can choose not to ask the remaining waiters for the Twi'lek dish, leaving themselves without a way to get the datadisk.<ref name="Raid" />
